label: XGS-PON OLT class N2, 8 ports
notes: ITU-T G.9807.1 Table B.9.3 (9.95328 Gbit/s downstream): OLT mean launched power +4.0..+7.0 dBm for class N2, ONU sensitivity -28.0 dBm. Upstream OLT receiver per Table B.9.4: -28.0 dBm sensitivity, -7.0 dBm overload. The 2023 edition's main body table splits N2 into N2a (+4..+8 dBm) and N2b (+10.5..+12.5 dBm); this part is the N2a low-power variant and quotes Table B.9.3, which is 1 dB tighter at the top. Class N2 assumes 16-31 dB of ODN loss (Table B.9.2): a shorter span can overload the ONT, so budget an attenuator rather than extra reach. Replace with the OLT's own datasheet for the line card actually purchased before construction.
